title: MZ Counter-attack when attacked with elemental skills

posts.author: sushibyte
posts.body:
Looking for wizards!
I want certain potions to  absorb and heal from elemental attacks. So you use the potion, it heals you, and then if you are ever attacked by fire for example, you heal a certain amount.
I want other potions to trigger a physical counter-attack when attacked with a specific element. So the potion heals you, and if you get attacked by fire, you counter attack.
I know that Counter attacks are triggered by physical attacks only? I have visustellah's plugin but can we create  States that can apply both my ideas?

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
Well, the potion would activate a state. I guess you figured that much out, right? And make that state 0% vulnerable for fire.
Now we need to make characters inflicted by that state heal when attacked with fire... The only know how is to use javascript in the battle damage formule of the fire attacks. Use an if statement to see if the target has that state, if so, add HP to the target. Then do
;
and then the damage formula.
I mean, this is not actually the engine reacting to the state, but you programming that healing into all skills that trigger it. The effect is the exact same for the player though. Fake it till you make it.
How to counter an element, I don't know.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
JohnDoeNews said:
And make that state 0% vulnerable for fire.
Click to expand...
an easier method involves not doing that. with turans eval tags or visustella's battle core, you could give the state a tag to invert the fire damage taken into healing or replace the damage with a static healing amount. Whatever OP needs. the latter isnt affected by an element rate, but the former would require the state to not modify it unless its meant to also reduce the damage healed.
Im not familiar enough with MZ to be able to give a solution for the counter portion though. i dont think yanfly's counter control got ported in any way to MZ and a quick search doesnt bring up anything usable. maybe FOSSIL could work with it, and if it does you could give each state a counter based on their element, but otherwise i have nothing.
EDIT: If you just wanted to deal damage back at the attacker and not necessarily counter attack, the first 2 plugins could also let you do that.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I don't know about VisuStella, but I think triacontane's CounterExtend could do this:
RPGMakerMV/CounterExtend.js at mz_master · triacontane/RPGMakerMV
RPGツクールMV、MZで動作するプラグインです。. Contribute to triacontane/RPGMakerMV development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
A counter rule can be applied to a state etc with a notetag. These rules are defined in the plugin's parameters and include a list of counter skills, each with their own conditions (e.g. element ID).
I doubt it's compatible with VisuStella, and the help/params are all in Japanese, but it may be worth a try if no-one has a better suggestion~

/*:
* @plugindesc Counterattack Extension Plugin
* @target MZ
* @url https://github.com/triacontane/RPGMakerMV/tree/mz_master/CounterExtend.js
* @base PluginCommonBase
* @author Triacontane
*
* @param CounterList
* @text Counterattack settings list
* @desc List of counterattack settings. Specify the identifier specified here from each memo field.
* @default []
* @type struct<COUNTER>[]
*
* @param ConsiderateRepeat
* @text Consider consecutive attacks
* @desc If enabled, you will only counterattack once for consecutive attacks or multiple actions by the opponent.
* @default false
* @type boolean
*
* @help CounterExtend.js
*
* Skills and items can be activated as a reaction (counterattack) to the opponent's actions.
* Counterattack settings can be set under a variety of conditions and settings.
* It works regardless of the "counterattack rate" feature that can be set by default.
*
* Please specify as follows in the memo field that has the feature (actor, job, weapon, armor, state, enemy character). If the battler has that feature, it will counterattack.
* For example, if you set it in the memo field of a state, the battler will counterattack when it is attacked by that state.
*
* <CounterExtend:aaa> # Counterattack with the counterattack setting that matches the identifier [aaa].
* <CounterExtend:aaa> # Same as above
* <CounterExtend:1> # Counterattack with the [1]th counterattack setting in the counterattack list.
* <CounterExtend:1> # Same as above
*
* Detailed counterattack settings can be entered from the plugin parameters.
* Unlike normal counterattacks, they are activated after the opponent's action is finished.
*
* When multiple counterattack tags are met at the same time, they are activated in the following order.
* State (in order of priority) > Actor, enemy character > Occupation > Equipment
*
* Skills and items entered in the memo field as follows can reduce the frequency of opponent counterattacks by the specified value.
* <CounterEvasion:100>
* <Counterattack avoidance:100>
*
* 〇Local variables that can be used in scripts
* subject -> Battler who counterattacks
* target -> Opponent battler
* triggerAction -> Action used by opponent battler
*
* 〇Variables that can be used in the calculation formula for counterattack skills
* a.lastHpDamage -> HP damage last taken by the counterattacker
*
* The base plugin "PluginCommonBase.js" is required to use this plugin.
* "PluginCommonBase.js" is stored in the following folder under the RPG Maker MZ installation folder.
* * dlc/BasicResources/plugins/official
*
*/

posts.author: caethyril

Nice!
Just to add to the other suggestions: I noticed VisuStella's Elements & Status Menu Core has an
<Element Absorb: X>
notetag that can be used on states. That might be a neater solution than a "counter-heal"? It's a common idea so there are probably other plugins that can do something similar, e.g. "absorb element" or "invert damage".
